raw.title: Arazzo Runner v0.9.2
raw.body:
## Features

- implement support for extracting application/x-www-form-urlencoded request/response bodies by @DavidAtJentic in https://github.com/jentic/arazzo-engine/pull/116
* allow oneOf and anyOf structures to be passed to the inputs field of an io object by @DavidAtJentic in https://github.com/jentic/arazzo-engine/pull/117

## Bugfixes
* ensure JSON Schema allOf keyword flattening and merging by @DavidAtJentic in https://github.com/jentic/arazzo-engine/pull/115

## Enhancements

* runner: provide development setup documentation

## New Contributors

* @Shrihari25-hub made their first contribution in https://github.com/jentic/arazzo-engine/pull/112 enhancing the state of the documentation

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jentic/arazzo-engine/compare/arazzo_runner/v0.9.1...arazzo_runner/v0.9.2
